title: llm.message.completed.v1
description: The gateway finished one assistant answer (M2 spec #32). Sent for every end state: completed, failed, canceled. CloudEvents subject: the message id. The tenantid extension holds the org id, the actor extension names the user. Metadata only: no prompt, no answer text.

message_id.description: Id of the assistant message. Same as the done event of the stream.

model.description: Model alias, for example default. Never a provider model name.

provider.description: Provider adapter that answered, for example ollama, openai_compat or fake.

input_tokens.description: Provider token count. Same as the usage event of the stream.

latency_ms.description: Time from the request to the end of the stream.

ttft_ms.description: Time to the first token. Absent when no token came.

status.description: completed: the answer is complete. failed: the model call failed. canceled: the client closed the stream.
